news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results of Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: The Lancet published full peer-reviewed efficacy, safety, PK/PD and biomarker data from the 16-week induction period of the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD trial, which met all primary and key secondary endpoints (EASI-75/90, Itch NRS, vIGA-AD, BSA) on the 24 microgram/kg q2w dose. It is described as the first large placebo-controlled trial validating T-reg modulation as a clinical mechanism for chronic inflammatory disease, and shares rallied toward 52-week highs on the news.

news.headline: Sell-side splits on Nektar after Q2 print: Canaccord initiates Buy ($153 PT), Piper Sandler reiterates Buy ($185 PT), JPMorgan reinstates Neutral
news.summary: In the days following Q2 earnings, Canaccord's Edward Nash initiated coverage with a Buy rating and $153 price target while Piper Sandler reiterated Buy at $185, citing rezpegaldesleukin momentum and Nektar's strong cash runway; JPMorgan reinstated coverage at Neutral. Consensus among covering analysts remains a Strong Buy with price targets well above the prevailing share price.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported Q2 2026 revenue of $10.1 million and a net loss of $40.6 million, ending the quarter with $1.02 billion in cash and investments and no debt, with cash runway now guided into Q3 2028, covering primary Phase 3 atopic dermatitis readouts. Shares dipped modestly on the print despite the strong balance sheet, as investors weighed continued cash burn against pipeline progress.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, the first two of three global registrational Phase 3 trials (each targeting ~510 patients, 1,530 total) evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in patients 12 and older with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. A third trial, ZENITH AD-3, enrolling treatment-experienced patients, is slated to begin in September 2026.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Third pivotal trial in the ZENITH AD program, enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic/JAK inhibitor treatment experience, expected to begin dosing.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata trial start
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to initiate a single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, building on positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA data.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly financial results and pipeline update; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Initial Phase 3 ZENITH AD topline data
catalysts.detail: First readouts from the ZENITH AD-1/AD-2/AD-3 registrational program in atopic dermatitis, the key value-inflection event for rezpegaldesleukin.

catalysts.label: Targeted BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Company-guided target for first Biologics License Application submission for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis.
